basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Sales Engineer / Solutions Architect | Production Agentic AI (LangGraph, ADK, MCP) | Evals, Tracing & Customer Outcomes
basics.summary: AI engineer and trusted technical advisor who ships production agents for a living and uses AI observability daily. Currently Lead AI Engineer at LumApps: production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph, Google ADK and MCP over GCP, instrumented end-to-end with evals, LangSmith tracing and cost-per-request telemetry. I am the buyer Arize sells to, so I can articulate its value with authority. Founder of Anand Creations, my forward-deployed practice for running discovery, POCs and productionization on live customer data. 6 years co-owning GTM launches with Sales, Product and CIO at Beekeeper (10M+ users), and 20+ startup discovery + advisory engagements at Tenity. Zurich-based, EMEA-remote, happy to travel to customers across the region.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Ship production multi-agent workflows (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP servers) on GCP Vertex AI with full observability: evals-as-tests, LangSmith tracing, tool-selection tuning and cost-per-request telemetry. Daily hands-on user of the exact category Arize AX competes in.
2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M/quarter revenue forecast. Concrete before/after numbers I use to translate technical wins into board-ready ROI stories.
Report to C-level on outcomes; run cross-functional reviews with Sales and Product. Fluent in translating stochastic agent behavior into language a CDO and a CFO can both act on.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we could pitch measurable impact within a week. Exactly the story-arc a Sales Engineer needs.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline (OpenAI + GitHub Actions) shipped in 6 weeks. A crisp PoC narrative I have used to unblock enterprise buyers on 'AI is too expensive to ship'.

Architected Employee Referral System ($1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA) and led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Production data engineering on AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.
Mentored the AI engineering cohort and ran discovery with prospects and CIO. Comfortable moving between board-level pitch and hands-on prototype in the same day.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Trusted technical advisor to 20+ fintech and AI startups. Ran discovery on GenAI stacks, evaluated architectures and turned findings into investment recommendations. Same discovery-to-value motion an AI Sales Engineer runs with prospects.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling algorithmic trading; advised portfolio companies on where AI observability and evals genuinely earn their keep.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL autonomous drone spin-off (nod to the JD's own team background). Shipped the end-to-end platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL on AWS) that ran 500+ real-world deliveries.

Ran enterprise sales conversations that landed a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase. First-hand experience taking an unproven AI platform through PoC, procurement and production with a Fortune 500 buyer.
